description: Prompt study: 5 GPT-5.6 Luna sessions at xhigh on fasttext, each one build node whose instructions are prompts/builder-checker.md (the loop's builder and checker prompts verbatim, Zeroshot's verifier guidance for the checker, and four sentences describing the loop), with a 6-hour time limit; otherwise luna-xhigh-fasttext-v1's task, model, resources, evaluation and pricing. Compared with luna-xhigh-fasttext-v1's check-and-repair loop at the sessions' mean cost (bench parity) and at their mean score (bench match).

task.adjustments_rationale: The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. This adjustment is general, not specific to the task. The bundled documentation is left as shipped: no task-specific corrections.
